name: token-diet
description: Command-output filtering for OMP: ctx-wire EN+FR filters for the four `dotnet` commands OMP's native shellMinimizer does not cover (publish, pack, run, tool), the `caveman` output-brevity skill, a PATH fix so the shims are visible without restarting your terminal, and an opt-in (off by default) context compressor. The runtime layer this plugin used to ship — read dedup, context dedup, a cache meter, a lean tool surface — is now native OMP and has been removed.
